post.title: How do cache servers scale to millions of users without losing data? | Consistent Hashing
post.brief:
Wondering how cache servers efficiently scale to millions of users without data loss? Discover the secret of consistent hashing in this quick guide on optimizing distributed systems.

What you will learn:
- The limitations of traditional modulo hashing.
- How consistent hashing works using a circular ring.
- Why only a fraction of keys are affected during server scaling.
- Techniques to balance load and prevent hotspots.

📖 Dive deeper and read the full guide here: https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/
